=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:8116-8162 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `select(.willCloseTarget == true ...)` drops PRs whenever `willCloseTarget` is absent or null, so older or partial GraphQL responses silently empty the cache.
  WHY: jq treats missing fields as null, which makes the filter reject every cross-referenced PR node instead of degrading gracefully.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1214-1231 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The GraphQL mock omits `willCloseTarget`, so the updated jq filter removes all `CrossReferencedEvent` PR nodes from the cache.
  WHY: In the mocked timeline node, `.willCloseTarget` is null and `select(.willCloseTarget == true ...)` filters out every linked PR, breaking tests that depend on `STALL_MANAGED_LINKED_PR_CACHE`.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9539-9580 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The REST fallback body regex is too broad and can match incidental prose in the PR body, so reference-only text is misclassified as a closing PR.
  WHY: The keyword/issue-number grep is not constrained tightly enough, so unrelated body text can satisfy the match and trigger merged-PR handling.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9539-9580 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When `_fetch_pr_json`/`jq` fails or returns `{}`, `_lpr_body` becomes empty and the fallback treats a valid closing PR as non-closing.
  WHY: The body check falls through as "no match" on API/JSON failure, which clears `_lpr_num` and skips the merged-PR guard.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9564-9569 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Interpolating `${issue_num}` directly into `grep -E` can produce a malformed regex and silently clear `_lpr_num` if a non-digit reaches this path.
  WHY: A regex parse error is swallowed by `2>/dev/null`, so the compound guard evaluates as no match and stall recovery proceeds incorrectly.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9555-9555 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `\b` is GNU-grep-specific and breaks closing-keyword detection on non-GNU grep implementations.
  WHY: On BSD/busybox grep the anchor is not interpreted as a word boundary, so valid `Closes #N` bodies are missed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:9557-9557 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `\$` matches a literal dollar sign instead of end-of-string in the URL-form regex.
  WHY: URL-form closing references at the end of the body can fail to match, so legitimate closing PRs are treated as references only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: `_lpr_body` becomes empty when `_fetch_pr_json` returns `{}` or otherwise fails.
  WHY: The body grep then finds no closing keywords, clears `_lpr_num`, and can silently skip a legitimate closing PR.
